verdict.rationale: Replit's first-party docs say Replit Agent connects to external tools through MCP. Users can sign in to a curated catalog of servers (Stripe, Linear, Notion, Sentry) or add a custom server by URL, so Agent can use those tools. The separate Replit MCP Server, which other clients connect to, is server-side and not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that MCP tool use works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Replit Agent can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Connect Replit Agent to external tools, data sources, and APIs through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) — sign in to a pre-listed server or add a custom one.
If the server you want isn't in the pre-listed catalog, add it by URL.
Replit ships with a curated list of MCP servers for popular services like Stripe, Linear, Notion, Sentry, and more.
